reviews.title: Bible Trivia Quiz Games
reviews.text: This Bible Trivia game is really outstanding.  It’s fun, and informative, not to mention great for my memory that was affected from Chemotherapy and Radiation.  I am completely surprised at how much I know, or remember. Mainly, because I only remember that I used to read the children’s Bible that I had as a child, and the children’s Bible that I used to read to my children, with the youngest being thirty six years old. The middle child is forty eight years old. The oldest, that passed on would be fifty two years old now, if he had lived! That’s why I am shocked that I get 98% of the quiz questions correct. I guess it was just really important to me. Or it’s because it affected me emotionally, as my Neurologist said, you remember what affects you emotionally. I love Jesus, I love God and I love this Bible Trivia game, and highly recommend it!
